scene: Through the brass telescope, three faraway travel hubs come sharply into view.
picture: A close circular view through the telescope's crosshairs. On the left sits a snow-dusted sleigh tram idling beside a frost sign. In the centre lies a sunny dock with a moored glass-bottomed boat. On the right, a bright striped hot-air balloon sways gently beside an open wicker basket.
shown: a frosted sleigh tram depot visible on the left edge of the lens view
a turquoise coastal pier with glass boat visible in the lens centre
a striped hot-air balloon moored to a post visible on the right
